In September 2026, Ontario's employment rate was higher than Quebec's.

| Province | Employment rate, Sept 2026 |
|---|---|
| Ontario | 60.1% |
| Quebec | 59.9% |

Ontario's rate was 0.2 percentage points higher. That gap is small, and these are survey estimates, so it may not be statistically meaningful.

These are seasonally adjusted rates for ages 15 and over, both genders combined.

Source: Statistics Canada, Table 14-10-0287-01, "Labour force characteristics, monthly, seasonally adjusted and trend-cycle". The vectors are v2063951 for Ontario and v2063762 for Quebec. The data were released 2026-10-09.
